name: OpenStreetMap
description: Free place search, nearby places with hours, and walking, cycling and driving routes from OpenStreetMap. Bots show them on maps in chat. No account or key needed.
installationSteps: Install this plugin from the marketplace.
Choose Connect. There is nothing to sign in to.
Ask a Bot for places, such as the best Thai food near a landmark, or a walking route between stops.

setup.title: Connect OpenStreetMap
setup.description: Uses OpenStreetMap's free public services: Photon for place search, Nominatim for nearby places and Valhalla for routes. No account or key is needed.
steps: Choose Connect. Every Bot can then look up places and routes.
Place names, search areas and route stops are sent to these public services. They don't receive your name or messages.
OpenStreetMap has hours, websites and phone numbers for many places, but no ratings, reviews or photos.

skills.name: openstreetmap-places
skills.description: When the user asks about real places: what is near somewhere, the best place of a kind, opening hours, or directions and routes between stops.
